title: Customer Success & Sales Executive
description:
Customer Success & Sales Executive

Salary: 27,000 per annum basic + monthly Bonus (OTE 32,000+)
Contract: Permanent Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm + 1 short Saturday per month
Location: Office-based in Hove / Portslade

Join a growing team with warm leads only - no cold calling!

We're looking for a Customer Success & Sales Executive to join an established and expanding organisation in Hove / Portslade. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone passionate about customer service and sales to work in a thriving, supportive environment.

You'll handle warm enquiries, provide exceptional customer support, and convert opportunities into sales through outstanding service and product knowledge.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to customer enquiries via phone, email, and live chat.
- Convert warm leads into successful sales through proactive follow-ups.
- Process orders accurately and resolve any delivery issues.
- Build strong customer relationships and ensure a positive experience.
- Gather feedback to improve products and services.
- Maintain accurate records of interactions and transactions.
- Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs.
- Stay updated on product knowledge and company policies.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in customer service or sales in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).
- Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-first mindset.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Apply now to join our client's team and contribute to their ongoing success. Interviewing asap.

- Please apply today with your up to date CV and contact details

title: Internal Sales Coordinator
description:
Internal Sales Coordinator

26k-28k

Are you organised, customer-focused and confident building relationships? We're looking for an Internal Sales Coordinator to join a successful business in Brighton.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys generating new business, supporting the sales process and helping to drive business growth in a professional and collaborative environment. The role offers a balance of customer service, sales support and account coordination, without the pressure of a heavily target-driven sales position.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Generating new business through indsutry research
- Ensuring data and contacts are correct and up to date
- Working closely with the Director to highlight potential new client leads
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with existing customers
- Identifying opportunities to maximise sales within existing accounts
- Maintaining accurate customer records within the CRM system
- Supporting the wider sales team with administration and reporting

What We're Looking For:
- Previous experience in internal sales, sales support, customer service or account coordination
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive approach and willingness to support commercial objectives
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a busy environment
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and CRM systems
- A positive attitude and strong team ethic

What's On Offer:
- Competitive basic salary
- Ongoing training and development
- Clear progression opportunities
- Friendly and supportive team culture
- Modern office environment
- Excellent company benefits package

If you're looking for a role that combines customer interaction, sales support and relationship management within a welcoming and collaborative business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Representative (Leisure Marine)
company: Grafters Recruitment Consultants Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Location: Hailsham, East Sussex

Join our clients dynamic team as a Sales Executive and drive your career forward with them! They are a leading company in the synthetic rope industry, committed to delivering market leading products, exceptional service and innovative solutions to their customers.

Role Overview: They are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Executive to join their Leisure Marine team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, building strong customer relationships, and achieving targets. If you have a passion for sales and a knack for connecting with people, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Key Responsibilities:
- Driving their van, stocked with product around chandleries and boatyards, selling marine equipment to achieve targets.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
- Provide excellent customer service and support.
- Keep up-to-date with product knowledge and market trends.

Requirements:
- Proven experience in sales, preferably with B2 B experience
- Keen interest in the marine, yachting or related industries.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and closing skills.
- Self-motivated and target-driven.
- Valid and clean driver's license.
- Ability and willingness to travel and stay away from home if and when necessary

We endeavour to reply to all applications, however, if you haven t heard from us within 7 days, you have been unsuccessful with this particular role. You are very welcome to apply to future advertisements placed by Grafters Recruitment Consultants / Grafters Accountancy Personnel.
